# ART BEAT

> ART BEAT is an art, music and dance studio in Vrindavan Colony, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. It teaches oil painting, acrylic painting, pencil shading and sketching; piano, guitar, tabla and singing; and dance — for all ages, beginner to advanced.

## Location
Eldeco Saubhagyam Club House, Sector 9, Vrindavan Colony (near LPS School), Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226029, India.

## Hours
The studio is open every day. Individual classes run on alternate days per batch; with multiple batches running, the studio operates daily.
- Monday–Saturday: 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Sunday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

## Programmes
- **Art:** oil painting, acrylic painting, pencil shading, sketching
- **Music:** piano, guitar, tabla, singing
- **Dance:** Zumba, Bollywood, group classes and individual coaching, all levels

## Instructors
- Shefali — founder; art faculty. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mudgalshefali/
- Ankit — art instructor
- Ayush — music instructor
- Rishabh — music instructor

## Past events
ART BEAT opened on 2 October with an open competition in art, music and dance as part of its opening day celebration, at Eldeco Saubhagyam Club. Open to all ages and levels.
